notes: Known from one sample flash posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy on 7 February 1999, titled "[Sample Flash] Pain & Suffering", served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/sample-flash-pain-suffering-1999-02-07.html. Sonia is the whip-wielding mistress who keeps the tag team Pain & Suffering as her "pets" over a pit of fire, ranks three punishments for the Marine Heidi, taunts Death & Destruction, who have the backing of the "MA", the Killing Machines and Badd Attitude, and boasts that her pets rose to number 20 of the top 200 tag teams in a few months. The handler's closing lines call Pain & Suffering the current IWF/WoW champions looking for a fed with a good tag division.
